steps.instruction: Search the photo library for images (not videos and not screenshots) whose capture time falls between 2019-05-20 and 2019-07-03. If the library search offers scene or object filters, use them to keep only photos of the inside of a home (rooms, walls, floors, kitchen, bathroom, fixtures) and say how many were left out; do not run the vision model in this step. For every photo return its photo identifier and file path as the library gives them, and its capture time read from the photo metadata. List photos with no capture time separately as undated. Change nothing. If there are no photos, return an empty list and say so plainly.
